title: KIP Registry
description: Gold-standard Key Information Points extracted manually from a single anonymized artifact. Each KIP is an atomic, verifiable fact that a wiki entry should capture.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier matching the filename in data/anonymized/ (without extension).

artifact_type.description: Source system category of the original artifact.

extracted_by.description: Person who manually extracted the KIPs.

validated_by.description: Domain expert who reviewed the KIPs. Null if not yet validated.

extraction_date.description: ISO 8601 date when extraction was performed.

validation_date.description: ISO 8601 date when domain expert validated. Null if not yet validated.

kips.description: List of extracted Key Information Points.

id.description: Sequential identifier scoped to this artifact (KIP-001, KIP-002, ...).

text.description: The atomic fact, stated as a concise declarative sentence.

category.description: Semantic category of the fact. Kept minimal for Phase 1; extend if needed during extraction.

source_hint.description: Optional rough location in the artifact (e.g., 'line 42', 'paragraph 3'). Aids traceability during scoring.
